system.system_name: <str> Name identifying the power system network.
system.num_buses: <int> Total number of buses (nodes) in the power network.
system.buses: <list[int], length num_buses> Identifiers for each bus in the network.

generators.bus: <int> Bus where this generator is located.
generators.existing: <bool> Whether this generator is already built (true) or is a candidate for investment (false).
generators.type: <str> Fuel or technology type of the generator (e.g., fossil, wind, solar).
generators.a_cost: <float> Constant term of the quadratic generation cost function ($/h).
generators.b_cost: <float> Linear term of the quadratic generation cost function ($/MWh).
generators.c_cost: <float> Quadratic term of the quadratic generation cost function ($/MW^2h).
generators.startup_cost: <float> Cost incurred each time the generator is started up ($).
generators.Pmin_MW: <float> Minimum power output when the generator is committed (MW).
generators.Pmax_MW: <float> Maximum power output capacity of the generator (MW).
generators.min_on_h: <int> Minimum number of consecutive hours the generator must remain on once started.
generators.min_off_h: <int> Minimum number of consecutive hours the generator must remain off once shut down.
generators.ramp_MW_per_h: <float> Maximum change in power output between consecutive hours (MW/h).
generators.capital_cost_per_kW: <float> Investment cost to build this candidate generator ($/kW), zero for existing units.

transmission_lines.id: <str> Unique identifier for this transmission line.
transmission_lines.from_bus: <int> Bus at one end of the transmission line.
transmission_lines.to_bus: <int> Bus at the other end of the transmission line.
transmission_lines.existing: <bool> Whether this line is already built (true) or is a candidate for investment (false).
transmission_lines.flow_limit_MW: <float> Maximum power that can flow through this line in either direction (MW).
transmission_lines.loss_factor: <float> Fraction of power lost during transmission on this line.
transmission_lines.capital_cost_per_kW: <float> Investment cost to build this candidate line ($/kW), zero for existing lines.

storage.id: <str> Unique identifier for this energy storage unit.
storage.bus: <int> Bus where this storage unit is located.
storage.existing: <bool> Whether this storage unit is already built (true) or is a candidate for investment (false).
storage.capacity_MW: <float> Maximum energy that can be stored or discharged per hour (MW).
storage.efficiency: <float> Round-trip efficiency of charging and discharging (fraction between 0 and 1).
storage.capital_cost_per_kW: <float> Investment cost to build this candidate storage unit ($/kW).

loads.bus: <int> Bus where this demand is located.
loads.annual_peak_load_MW: <float> Peak electricity demand at this bus in the base year (MW).

scenario_parameters.num_stages: <int> Number of investment decision stages in the planning horizon.
scenario_parameters.num_upper_level_scenarios: <int> Total number of leaf scenarios in the upper-level scenario tree.
scenario_parameters.num_lower_level_scenarios_per_day: <int> Number of operational uncertainty samples drawn per representative day.
scenario_parameters.num_representative_days: <int> Number of typical days used to represent annual operations.
scenario_parameters.hours_per_day: <int> Number of hourly time periods within each representative day.
scenario_parameters.investment_period_years: <int> Length of each investment stage in years.
scenario_parameters.upper_level_branching_factor: <int> Number of child nodes per parent in the scenario tree.
scenario_parameters.cost_variation_percent: <float> Fractional change in investment costs between high and low branches of the scenario tree.
scenario_parameters.demand_growth_high_percent: <float> Fractional demand growth per stage in the high-growth branch of the scenario tree.
scenario_parameters.demand_growth_low_percent: <float> Fractional demand growth per stage in the low-growth branch of the scenario tree.

scenario_tree.id: <int> Unique identifier for this scenario tree node.
scenario_tree.stage: <int> Investment stage to which this node belongs.
scenario_tree.parent_id: <int or null> Identifier of this node's parent node, null for the root.
scenario_tree.probability: <float> Unconditional probability of reaching this node from the root.
scenario_tree.children: <list[int]> Identifiers of this node's child nodes, empty for leaf nodes.

representative_days.id: <int> Unique identifier for this representative day.
representative_days.season: <str> Season of the year this day represents (spring, summer, fall, winter).
representative_days.day_type: <str> Whether this is a weekday or weekend day.
representative_days.load_profile: <list[float], length hours_per_day> Hourly fraction of peak load for this representative day.
representative_days.solar_profile: <list[float], length hours_per_day> Hourly solar capacity factor for this representative day.

wind_weibull_params.k: <float> Shape parameter of the Weibull distribution used to generate wind speeds for this day.
wind_weibull_params.c: <float> Scale parameter of the Weibull distribution used to generate wind speeds for this day (m/s).

{representative_day_id}.scenario_id: <int> Identifier for this operational scenario within a representative day.
{representative_day_id}.demand_multipliers: <list[float], length hours_per_day> Hourly random multiplier applied to the base load profile to produce realized demand.
{representative_day_id}.solar_multipliers: <list[float], length hours_per_day> Hourly random multiplier applied to the base solar profile to produce realized solar output.
{representative_day_id}.wind_power_factors: <list[float], length hours_per_day> Hourly realized wind power capacity factor derived from sampled wind speeds.

global_parameters.reserve_margin_requirement: <float> Required fraction of excess installed capacity above peak demand for system reliability.
global_parameters.storage_efficiency: <float> Round-trip efficiency applied to all storage units.
global_parameters.spinning_reserve_percent: <float> Fraction of hourly load that must be covered by online spinning reserve.

capital_costs_per_kW.coal: <float> Reference investment cost for coal-fired generation ($/kW).
capital_costs_per_kW.natural_gas: <float> Reference investment cost for natural gas generation ($/kW).
capital_costs_per_kW.solar: <float> Reference investment cost for solar generation ($/kW).
capital_costs_per_kW.wind: <float> Reference investment cost for wind generation ($/kW).
capital_costs_per_kW.transmission_line: <float> Reference investment cost for transmission lines ($/kW).
capital_costs_per_kW.energy_storage: <float> Reference investment cost for energy storage ($/kW).

derating_factors.fossil: <float> Capacity credit fraction for fossil generators toward the reserve margin.
derating_factors.wind: <float> Capacity credit fraction for wind generators toward the reserve margin.
derating_factors.solar: <float> Capacity credit fraction for solar generators toward the reserve margin.

global_parameters.wind_cutin_speed_m_per_s: <float> Minimum wind speed at which wind turbines begin producing power (m/s).
global_parameters.wind_rated_speed_m_per_s: <float> Wind speed at which wind turbines reach full rated output (m/s).
